issues.claim: "Faith & Trade", Christian book store, 388 Washington Rd, (732) 307-2114
issues.problem: Sources disagree on both address and category: the bulk directory used gives 388 Washington Rd as a Christian bookstore, while a Superpages listing for the identical phone gives 383 Washington Rd and categorises it as a fundraising service (there is also a 'Faith and Trade Helping Hands' nonprofit registered in Sayreville). No page was found showing a retail bookstore at either address.
issues.fix: Cold-verify by phone that a retail store exists at the correct address; if it is the nonprofit/fundraising entity or 383 Washington Rd, re-label or remove the entry.

issues.claim: "Appliance Repair Sayreville", 66 Main St, Unit 7, Sayreville, website appliancerepairsayreville.com
issues.problem: The site is a templated service-area marketing site: it never states an address (no match for '66 Main' or 'Sayreville' in body text, though the brand name is in the title/URL) and the 'book now' flow is a lead form. The claimed storefront address is unverified.
issues.fix: Treat as a service business rather than a shopfront, or verify the 66 Main St unit before listing; flag the website as a lead-generation site, not a storefront site.

issues.claim: Boundary: Circle Motor Lodge, 1 Victory Plaza (listed town South Amboy)
issues.problem: The motel's own directions page gives 1 Victory Plaza, South Amboy 08879 and no Sayreville address. Zone membership rests only on Sayreville Res. 2024-31 licensing it — verified, but this is an inference, not an address confirmation.
issues.fix: Keep flagged as inference-only, or substitute a confirmed Sayreville-address motel; do not treat its address as in-zone in outreach copy.

issues.claim: Nonprofit / religious-linked entries (Sayreville VFW Post 4699 Banquet Hall, ShareGood Thrift Shoppe)
issues.problem: Both are operated by nonprofits (a veterans' post and two United Methodist churches) rather than independent commercial retailers. The VFW hall and the thrift shop do sell to the public, so they are not worship or government, but they sit at the edge of the group D rule.
issues.fix: Keep if the rule is 'sells to the public', otherwise move to an appendix; state the nonprofit status in the notes (ShareGood's is stated, the VFW's is not).

issues.claim: Four separate entries share 388 Washington Rd (Kroshka Day Care, Happy Home Appliances, A Step In Time Dance Center, Faith & Trade)
issues.problem: A four-tenant address is plausible for a plaza, and two tenants (A Step In Time, Happy Home Appliances) are confirmed there by their own sites, but Faith & Trade's address conflicts and no page confirms Kroshka's unit C.
issues.fix: Verify Kroshka's unit and Faith & Trade's address; multi-tenant addresses in bulk directories are a common data artefact.

issues.claim: Websites omitted for businesses that have them

issues.fix: Fill in the website fields so the entries carry a primary source.
